comments.body:
So, did you google data scientist position in google jobs and see what they are looking for?  
It looks like as minimum they almost all require (sometimes a bachelor is enough, usually in india): Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.  
In some of the jobs requirements data science is not explicitly listed, but I would speculate it has more to do with the fact that is a more recent degree and anyway they always add "a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience"  
So I don't think it makes a huge difference nowadays, it really depends on what you would like to work on and do, so as someone else said compare the coursework of both masters and pick based on what you may like. 

If you are trying to apply to eth most likely you would like to work in google Zurich, but as a data scientist that may be very hard without a phd.

Good luck.
comments.author: LockTheMoon
